findings.text: follow-on: cached_exterior duplicates the load-or-build orchestration and the exterior build body owned by scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:1343 cached_fixture_exterior, and cached_carrier at :210 forks measure.py:783 cached_machine, so a fix to the build or the flow must now land in two places; the fixture owners could instead have taken a store argument.

follow-on: `assert entry == published` compares fixture_entry(kind, fixture_digest(identity)) against publish_fixture(kind, fixture_digest(identity), ...), so both sides are derived from the same test-supplied digest and the assertion holds whatever fixture_digest does; the independent guard is the following is-None assertion at :243.

follow-on: no assertion covers the hit path, so a regression in _load_or_build that always rebuilt would leave the certificate gate green (six passed) and show only in the walls; the added negative control exercises the key, not the load-on-hit.

item_verdicts.diff: read commit by commit 0ebe45a..4d813488a; 957e1b1e8 adds certificate_fixtures.py and rewires book.py, bdddc614b names the exterior support arm, 5e7383f66/d632f6249/4d813488a carry the figure and the fragment, all inside the declared scope.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when's quantitative measure is a two-run H200 gate with per-row build/load walls, matching verdicts, a negative control and a suite delta; h200/slurm-1287655.out records RUN1 6 passed (10750.76s) then RUN2 6 passed (891.00s), GATE_EXIT=0, and the negative-control log records a failing arm, so the gate the worker ran asserts the named measure.
item_verdicts.goal: node goal is to load the certificate booking gate's carrier and exterior fixtures from an identity-keyed shared cache; scripts/prototypes/support/book.py:48-58 now calls certificate_fixtures.cached_carrier and cached_exterior, so both are addressed by the fixture sources' own identity and published under operand_cache_root()/certificate-fixtures.
item_verdicts.manifest: read manifest.md; status complete, it names the five commits, the gate command tests/test_current_book_fragments.py::test_analytic_certificate_moments, both suite arms, and the H200 and CPU log paths.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's declared paths are scripts/prototypes/support, scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py, four tests, tests/jaxpr_scans.py and the fragment/figures dirs; every path in the diff resolves inside them.

justifications.durability: tests/test_current_book_fragments.py:243 fails when fixture_digest is coarsened to drop discretisation.requested_cells, as cpu/negative_control.log shows, but nothing asserts that a second run loads rather than rebuilds.
justifications.evidence: h200/slurm-1287655.out:81 shows RUN1 6 passed and :143 shows RUN2 6 passed with GATE_EXIT=0, and cpu/negative_control.log:1 records the failing arm, though the CPU head arm in cpu/after_suite.json was run at 957e1b1e8 rather than the reviewed head.
justifications.fit: certificate_fixtures.py:125 publishes through nova.database.content_store and book.py:50 keeps the "store under the kind root" assertion the surrounding module style uses, though the _DeclaredFile shim at certificate_fixtures.py:157 is not a dataclass.
justifications.goal_fidelity: book.py:49 and book.py:58 replace the per-run tempfile root and the ZarrStore redirect with certificate_fixtures.cached_carrier/cached_exterior, which read the identity-keyed object before building, so the gate loads what a prior run published.
justifications.reuse: certificate_fixtures.py:251 cached_exterior re-implements the load-or-build flow and copies the exterior build body of scripts/analytic_oracle_fixtures/measure.py:1343 cached_fixture_exterior, and certificate_fixtures.py:210 cached_carrier forks measure.py:783 cached_machine rather than extending either owner.
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in git diff 0ebe45a..4d813488a is inside the manifest's declared write paths, including the two doc commits, and measure.py was left untouched as the brief permits.
